text:
jessica (Finance): Quick follow-up from last night's billing postmortem — we've identified three scopes: token re-ingest backfill, invoice crediting, and long-tail recurrence detection. I'll propose owners and due dates below. Please ack or reassign.

michael (Billing Eng): Ack. I can own token re-ingest. Planning ETA end of week for the backfill job.

anjali (SRE): I'll take long-tail recurrence detection. Want to add metrics + alert. ETA Tue next week.

tom (Product Ops): I'll own invoice crediting policy + customer comms. Need finance sign-off by Friday.

jessica (Finance): Action items:
- Michael: run backfill pipeline to reprocess the 2026-03-20 00:00-06:00 window, estimate runtime 6-8h. Due: 2026-03-28 EOD.
- Tom: draft crediting table + email template, due 2026-03-26 COB.
- Anjali: create recurrence detection dashboard + paging runbook, due 2026-03-30.
- Leah: hold list of affected accounts & high-touch customers, due 2026-03-25.

michael (Billing Eng): SQL I used to surface delayed batches:
```
SELECT batch_id, count(*) as tokens, min(event_ts), max(event_ts)
FROM token_ingest
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20' AND '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY batch_id
HAVING max(event_ts) - min(event_ts) > interval '2 hours';
```
Will run tonight and post results.

leah (Customer Ops): I'll prep the impacted accounts CSV, focusing on > $1k mo spend. Will coordinate comms w/ Tom.

tom (Product Ops): @leah please add subscription IDs + contact owner column.

billing-bot: Deploy success: token-reprocess-job v2.1 started by michael at 2026-03-25T02:15Z.

michael (Billing Eng): quick update: backfill currently at 20% after 90m, bumping parallelism 4->8. Estimated remaining 5h.

anjali (SRE): Opened alert: billing.delay.rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m — linked runbook here: <runbook link>

jessica (Finance): Note on credits: we prefer invoiced adjustments vs one-off credits for audit trail. Tom/Leah coordinate.

tom (Product Ops): Draft done, shared in #docs. Requesting finance approval @jessica.

jessica (Finance): Approved. Tom proceed. Leah start outreach early next week. I'll track in postmortem action tracker.

michael (Billing Eng): Backfill complete. Tokens re-ingested: 3,412,890. Triggering invoice re-calc job now.

billing-bot: Invoice recalculation job queued by michael at 2026-03-25T09:45Z.

leah (Customer Ops): Recalcs done for high-touch accounts. Scheduling calls with top 10 tomorrow.

anjali (SRE): Added recurrence detection dashboard and alert thresholds; paging policy sent to #eng-oncall.

jessica (Finance): Closing loop: owners updated, timelines met except the recurrence dashboard which slipped 2 days but OK. I'll close action items in tracker after final customer confirmations. Thanks team :tada:
